args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions. The first rollback attempt partially failed (us-east only) due to an orchestrator error; a retry completed the rollout to all regions. Service verified healthy on v2.3.0 with an error rate of 0.2%. Follow-up: investigate v2.3.1 for the root cause and investigate the orchestrator error that caused the partial rollback failure.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
The incident was created despite the timeout — it's listed as INC-0001 and open, so no duplicate needed.

## Summary

**Issue:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production — in all regions. The first attempt partially failed (only us-east rolled back due to an orchestrator error), so I retried and it completed successfully across all three regions.
2. **Verified recovery:** checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions, error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) documenting the failure, the rollback, the orchestrator error during the first rollback attempt, and follow-up items (root-cause v2.3.1, investigate the orchestrator partial-failure). The on-call engineer has been paged.

**Note:** The incident creation tool returned a timeout, but I confirmed the incident was successfully created, so the on-call engineer is paged.
